description: This Java class 'JpaDeviceDao' implements data access object (DAO) for 'Device' entities in a SQL database, providing methods for querying, counting, and retrieving device data, including filtering by tenant, profile, type, and other attributes.

classes.name: JpaDeviceDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing Device entities in SQL database, implementing DeviceDao interface with methods for querying and counting devices.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO, which is DeviceEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JpaRepository instance used for DeviceEntity operations.

methods.name: findDeviceInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves DeviceInfo by device ID within a tenant.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds devices for a tenant with optional text search, returning paginated data.

methods.name: findDeviceInfosByFilter
methods.description: Finds device info filtered by various criteria with pagination.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByNamePrefix
methods.description: Finds entity info with name prefix within a tenant.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds devices by tenant ID and list of device IDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByIds
methods.description: Finds devices by a list of device IDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds devices by IDs.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds devices for a tenant and customer with pagination.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndProfileId
methods.description: Finds devices for a tenant and profile ID with pagination.

methods.name: findDeviceIdsByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileTransportType
methods.description: Finds device IDs filtered by transport type with pagination.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdCustomerIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds devices by tenant, customer, and device IDs.

methods.name: findDeviceByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and device name, returns Optional.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID and device type with pagination.

methods.name: findDeviceIdsByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Finds device IDs by tenant and device profile ID with pagination.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndTypeAndEmptyOtaPackage
methods.description: Finds devices with no OTA firmware/software package of a specific type.

methods.name: countDevicesByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileIdAndEmptyOtaPackage
methods.description: Counts devices with no OTA firmware/software package of a specific type.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant, customer, and type with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantDeviceTypesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves active device profile names for a tenant.

methods.name: findDeviceByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: findDeviceByTenantIdAndIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds a device by tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: countDevicesByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Counts devices associated with a specific device profile.

methods.name: countByTenantId
methods.description: Counts total devices for a tenant.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds devices associated with a specific edge within a tenant.

methods.name: findDevicesByTenantIdAndEdgeIdAndType
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant, edge, and device type.

methods.name: findDeviceIdInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated device ID info.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated profile entity ID info.

methods.name: findProfileEntityIdInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves profile entity ID info filtered by tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a device by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds devices by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external device ID from internal ID.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all devices for a tenant.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves next batch of device fields for processing.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DEVICE.
